description: No account needed. The all-in price range a brand pays per post in one format (post, quote or thread) across every creator on sale now, and that range times the number of posts you name (1 to 50), with how many creators sell that format and when the numbers were read. A guest gets 3 quotes in any 7 days from one address (quotes_left says how many remain); the next is refused with rate_limited (reason guest_quote_limit, retry_after and resets_at). A range, not a plan: a plan names creators and dates and needs an account (claim says where to sign in and create a key).

format.description: post (an original post), quote (a quote repost) or thread. Default post.
